links.comparator_used: Review-all, review-none, and a simple clinical rule
links.outcome: Net benefit (decision curve analysis) of model-triggered chart review for next-day ICU transfer, and feasible trial-recruitment yield under an 8-hour daily limit
links.effect: Model-guided strategies had higher net benefit than all comparators across thresholds (ROC AUC 0.80-0.84). At a feasible threshold of 0.23 the model flagged ~23 charts/day and yielded ~1.23 enrollments/day under conservative eligibility and consent assumptions.
links.tradeoff: Review workload had to fit an 8-hour daily time constraint covering chart review and consent effort; the threshold was chosen to be feasible within that limit.
links.quote: Across thresholds, model guided strategies outperformed review-all, review-none, and a simple clinical rule.

design_hint: alert threshold selection via decision curve analysis
